search_text: published ZDI-22-881 ZDI-CAN-16552 Advantech iView findCfgDeviceList COLUMN/VALUE SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2022-06-30 CVE-2022-2135 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2022-2135 9.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Advantech'] ['iView'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Advantech iView. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the NetworkServlet endpoint, which listens on TCP port 8080 by default. When parsing the COLUMN and VALUE elements of the findCfgDeviceList action, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM. Advantech has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Advantech iView findCfgDeviceList COLUMN/VALUE SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Advantech iView. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the NetworkServlet endpoint, which listens on TCP port 8080 by default. When parsing the COLUMN and VALUE elements of the findCfgDeviceList action, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
